d:
A Houthi drone hits a tower in Riyadh’s financial district, injuring 11 people as Saudi Arabia faces near-daily missile and drone attacks. Oil rises as tanker attacks around the Strait of Hormuz keep regional risks elevated, while OPEC+ prepares for one of its most important supply decisions of the year.
Global markets remain under pressure. Asian stocks fall as doubts over the AI trade return, the Nasdaq 100 slides and Treasuries gain as investors move back into havens. Copper approaches bear-market territory, gold falls and the LME tightens rules on large aluminum positions.
